caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a flat, round lid and decorative motifs. The lower right portion of the drawing features a colored rendering of the container, showing a black base color with symmetrical, fan-shaped patterns in yellow, light brown, and red on the sides, and additional similar motifs on the lid. Two line drawings in the upper left show the container from a front and a side view, highlighting the decorative pattern in outline only. Below these views, a circular top view is illustrated with swirling and leafy patterns in line art. A small linear scale marked in inches is also included underneath the top view. The composition is laid out on beige paper, with all the drawings enclosed in a rectangular frame.
title: Toleware Tea Caddy
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
